parameters.name: DeployResourceType
parameters.description:
The deployment resource type. Valid values:

- Kubernetes: Kubernetes cluster type.
- Ecs: ECS instance.
- FC: Function Compute.
- SWAS: simple application servers.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the deployment artifact.

parameters.name: Hooks
parameters.description: The deployment hook scripts, including the commands to run when the application starts or stops.

parameters.name: Location
parameters.description: The deployment location information, including the bucket name and region.

parameters.name: RevisionType
parameters.description:
The type of the deployment artifact. Valid values:

- Command: command type.
- GitRepo: Git repository type.
- HelmChart: Helm chart type.
- Oss: Object Storage Service type.
- EcsImage: ECS image.
- DockerImage: Docker image.
- Yaml: YAML file.
